purpose: Bound job monitoring and control materialization while retaining complete immutable inputs and original numerical/research semantics.
index: Transactionally cache small detail/list input projections bound to a canonical payload fingerprint and their own digest. Status/list/control response reads must not select jobs.payload or decode its JSON. Live lifecycle columns remain authoritative. Legacy backfill streams one job at a time, preserves original payload/result/trials and labels its provenance.
inputs: An explicit on-demand inputs endpoint retains every original field/configuration/proposal/news/borrowing/context snapshot. Verify the raw payload against its frozen trial-plan event before exporting or repairing an index. Do not silently rewrite or repair corrupt original inputs.
projection: Expose counts and bounded scalar metadata, not full configuration/proposal/recipe arrays or large assumption documents. Small complete contexts may be retained; any abbreviated large context is explicitly a summary with count and full-input link, never a complete context. Do not impose any new dataset/configuration constraint. Polling message previews are bounded and marked when shortened; full stored diagnostics remain available on demand.
corruption: A bad cached projection exposes a visible integrity error without treating its cached values as verified; other jobs and lifecycle controls remain usable. Explicit repair requires original input integrity and only rebuilds the derived cache. Preserve original trials and results.
verification: prespecified10/100/1000 and100000 queued-plan metadata bytes/materialization measurements, separate from numerical throughput
